credit: FantasticCurrency stats projector - a plinth for the hologram above it (tools/gen_machine_textures.py)
__comment: Low and flat on purpose. The block is a mount; the thing worth looking at is the floating text the block entity renderer draws over it, and a tall model would compete with it.

elements.name: lens
elements.__comment: A thin lit disc sitting a fraction above the plinth's top face, so the emitter reads as a separate part instead of a pattern painted on the lid.

elements.name: brand_band
elements.__comment: A tinted skirt around the plinth, carrying the colour of the bank that issued the board. Same trick as the ATM's livery: drawn in greys and multiplied at render time, so a board tells you whose figures it is showing before you have read any of them. An unbranded board - the server-wide one - keeps the default steel.
